formula: MEDIAN(business days from requisition submission to the first approver action)
cohort_rule: Requisitions with a submission and at least one approver action

formula: MEDIAN(stage entry to next-stage entry, business days) across all stage occurrences
cohort_rule: Every stage occurrence of every case; the per-stage split is in kpi_stage_breakdown

formula: MEAN(business minutes between an outgoing event and the next responsible actor's first action) / 510
cohort_rule: Events where responsibility moved between personas (handoff_flag = Y)

formula: MEDIAN(business days from Requisition Approved to Recruiter Assigned)
cohort_rule: Approved requisitions that reached recruiter assignment

formula: MEDIAN(business days from sourcing launch to the first shortlisted candidate)
cohort_rule: Requisitions that were posted and produced at least one shortlisted candidate

formula: MEDIAN(business days from Interview Requested to Interview Confirmed); rescheduling is T2-19/T2-17
cohort_rule: Interview rounds that reached a confirmed slot

formula: COUNT(breached intervals) / COUNT(measured intervals); severity = MEAN(minutes beyond target)
cohort_rule: All measured SLA intervals. Mean severity when breached: 2.63 business days

formula: COUNT(shortlisted candidates progressing to an interview) / COUNT(shortlists submitted)
cohort_rule: Applications submitted to a hiring manager; pending reviews stay in the denominator only when a decision has been reached

formula: MEDIAN(business days from Application Received to Resume Screening Completed)
cohort_rule: Applications with a completed screening decision

formula: MEAN(longest gap between consecutive progression events per application); reminders excluded
cohort_rule: All applications. Follow-up and reminder events are excluded so a chase cannot hide a wait

formula: COUNT(assessments completed) / COUNT(assessments assigned); expiry rate reported alongside
cohort_rule: Applications with an assessment assigned. Expiry rate 2.2%

formula: MEDIAN(business days from the last Offer Sent to the candidate's final response)
cohort_rule: Offers with a final response. 12 offers were still pending at the cut-off and are excluded

formula: COUNT(offers with >=1 negotiation or revision event) / COUNT(offers sent)
cohort_rule: Applications with an offer sent

formula: MEDIAN(business days from Compensation Proposal Created to Offer Approved); returns counted alongside
cohort_rule: Offers that reached approval. Mean returns/revisions per offer: 0.39

formula: MEDIAN(business days from Offer Accepted to Joining Readiness Confirmed)
cohort_rule: Accepted offers that reached joining readiness

formula: COUNT(accepted offers that did not convert to a joining) / COUNT(mature accepted offers)
cohort_rule: Accepted offers with an evidenced joining or non-joining outcome

formula: MEAN(returns to an already-completed activity or stage per case)
cohort_rule: Completed cases. Repeated interview rounds are legitimate repetition and are not counted

formula: COUNT(requisitions returned or resubmitted for missing information) / COUNT(requisitions)
cohort_rule: All requisitions

formula: COUNT(applications with feedback past SLA or returned for missing fields) / COUNT(applications with feedback)
cohort_rule: Applications with at least one submitted interview feedback

formula: COUNT(eligible cases with every mandatory approval/check evidenced) / COUNT(eligible cases)
cohort_rule: Cases that reached a step requiring a mandatory control; documented exceptions count as complete

formula: COUNT(cases with a missing mandatory control and no documented exception) / COUNT(cases)
cohort_rule: All cases

formula: MEAN(weighted open requisition load per recruiter per weekly snapshot)
cohort_rule: Weekly recruiter snapshots. Median 7.07, P90 14.09, aged (>60 days) requisitions per snapshot 2.51

formula: MEAN(events with manual_touch_flag = Y per case)
cohort_rule: All cases. Only evidenced manual actions count - a human-owned event is not assumed manual

formula: MEAN(reminder, chase and scheduling-coordination events per case)
cohort_rule: All cases, counting only the follow-up activities listed in kpi_core.FOLLOW_UP_ACTIVITIES

formula: SUM(duration_minutes of events on filled requisitions) / 60 / COUNT(hires)
cohort_rule: Hires on filled requisitions. Duration coverage 13.0% of events - this is measured effort only, never total effort

formula: COUNT(cases with a failed cross-system handoff) / COUNT(cases); lag = recovery time to sync completion
cohort_rule: All cases. Mean recovery lag when a sync failed: 1.42 business days, 760 retries, 176 manual re-entries
